task: Replace the per-push Jev REV gate with REV's deterministic tests gate, with Jev reviewing the contract once per digest.

criteria.description: The per-push Jev evaluation is removed: no workflow references a TypeSafe API key or endpoint or the rev-evidence job, the tests job no longer runs REV evidence steps, scripts/rev-evidence.mjs and its test are deleted, and .rev/ contains only the new gate's files.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > removes the per-push Jev gate and its evidence collector

criteria.description: The REV job runs aviarytech/rev pinned to a full commit SHA in tests scope unless cancelled, for pull requests, after every other CI job; those jobs are also the contract's required checks. Its only steps download the input artifact, run REV and upload the report: no run step, API key or secret. It takes the reviewed digest from the PR-specific REV_CONTRACT_PR_<number> repository variable. The rev-tests job checks out the same REV commit.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > runs pinned REV in tests scope after every CI job, from artifacts only, without an API key

criteria.description: The rev-tests job checks out the PR head without credentials, collects the change, then runs .rev/run-tests.mjs on head sources and on a merge-base worktree, in that order. run-tests.mjs copies the head's named test files onto the base sources, runs .test.ts files under Bun from their nearest package directory and .test.mjs/.test.js files under Node from the repository root, rejects other files, and writes repository-relative test IDs bound to the given source and test SHAs. Tests that fail or cannot load on base are reported as not passed rather than aborting the run.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > rev-tests runs the named tests on head sources and on a merge-base worktree
.rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > runs Node and Bun named tests on head and base, copying head tests onto base sources

criteria.description: The REV guide shows the tests-change.js and review-contract.js commands in the argument order those scripts accept, including --pin onionoriginals/sdk PR_NUMBER and a dry run without --pin. It explains version 2 criteria with tests and paths, REV_CONTRACT_PR_<number>, that Jev never runs per push, and that changing a named test file causes contract-mismatch. The workflow README says the gate needs no API key and Jev reviews each contract once; the PR template's checklist covers criteria, path globs, tests that fail without the change, and contract review. Both link the guide.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > documents per-PR criteria, Jev contract review and digest pinning

criteria.description: The PR adds an empty changeset, so no package release is produced.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > adds an empty changeset so no package is released
